Container.Name: TasmoBackup-py
Container.Overview:
Backup all your Tasmota and WLED devices from one web UI - a modern Python rewrite of TasmoBackup.
Scheduled and on-demand backups (Tasmota .dmp, WLED config + presets), one-click restore, device discovery via IP scan or MQTT, online status with ntfy/Gotify/webhook alerts, Tasmota time-zone check, and an optional firmware auto-update that is opt-in per device and always takes a fresh backup first.
Login-protected, device passwords encrypted at rest, no tracking. German and English UI.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: tasmota wled sonoff esp8266 esp32 backup firmware ota tasmobackup
Container.Requires: Tasmota/WLED devices reachable over HTTP from the Unraid server.
Container.Changes: ### 0.2.0 (2026-09-19) - Custom firmware builds (not release-...) are never auto-updated; the update button warns - Failed restores are detected (Tasmota answers HTTP 200 either way) - Invalid settings are refused instead of silently stopping all backups - Deleting a device also deletes its backups - "Back up all" runs in parallel; same-named devices no longer overwrite each other - MQTT password stored encrypted; messages translated; confirm dialogs safe with quotes in names - Dependency versions capped at the next major release ### 0.1.0 (2026-09-14) - Initial Community Applications release - PUID/PGID support, secret key generated automatically on first start

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, secret key and all device backups.

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: Web UI login name. Only used on the very first start.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Initial web UI password. Only used on the very first start - change it later in Settings.

Config.Name: Default Tasmota user
Config.Description: Web login used for devices without their own credentials.

Config.Name: Default Tasmota password
Config.Description: Web password used for devices without their own credentials. Leave empty if your devices have none.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to generate one automatically (stored in appdata). If set, never change it - stored device passwords could no longer be decrypted.

Config.Name: Login enabled
Config.Description: Set to false only if an external auth proxy protects the web UI.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default: 100 = users).
